#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

typedef long long int64_t;
typedef pair<int64_t, int64_t> pair_t;

const int64_t N = 1e5 + 2;
const int64_t INF = 1e9 + 7;
const double EPS = 1e-15;

int64_t n, x, y;
double cur_dif = INF;
pair_t ans;

void update(int64_t b, int64_t a) {
    double dif = abs(1. * a / b - 1. * x / y);
    if (dif + EPS < cur_dif) {
        cur_dif = dif;
        ans = {b, a};
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    for (int64_t b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
        int64_t a1 = x * b / y;
        int64_t a2 = a1 + 1;
        update(b, a1);
        update(b, a2);
    }
    cout << ans.second << '/' << ans.first;
    return 0;
}
